observations: Black mirrorless camera sitting on its original retail box.
The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS' branding.
The model 'EOS R100' is printed on the top right of the camera body.
An 18-45mm lens is attached to the body.
The box also displays 'Canon EOS R100'.
The camera appears to be in clean cosmetic condition from the front view.

claims.claim: most compact and affordable entry-level mirrorless camera
claims.evidence: This is a marketing claim about the model's market position.

risks.risk: Internal sensor damage or heavy dust
risks.proof: A clear photo of the sensor with the lens removed.
Close-up photos of the front and rear glass elements of the lens.
A video showing the camera powering on, the screen working, and the shutter firing.
A photo showing the battery and charger included.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the sensor with the lens removed.
Photos of the front and rear lens glass.
Photo of the battery, charger, and any other included accessories.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Canon EOS R100 with a kit lens. It can be priced at its worst-case (non-functional/parts) value until proof of operation is provided.
